$comment: The read half of the surface. Registered verbatim by src/tools.ts through fromJsonSchema, so what a client sees is this file. Branch requirements (task needs `key`) are stated in the `what` description and enforced in the handler, which can name the missing field; they are deliberately NOT allOf/if/then, which cost bytes in every conversation to say it less well.
name: read
title: Read a graph
description: Read a task graph: the board, the ready queue, one task in full, the graphs on this connector, or a Mermaid diagram. Pick with `what`. Results are summaries — the whole graph lives at taskdag://graph/<handle>.

what.description: board: counts + ready queue, and draws the card. ready: startable tasks only. task: one task whole — detail, dependencies, what blocks it (needs `key`). graphs: every graph on this connector. mermaid: a diagram — narrow it with keys/depth/direction/status, it is the one answer that costs real tokens.

graph.description: Graph handle from an earlier result. Omit for the most recent.

limit.description: How many ready tasks to name; the rest are counted.

keys.description: Draw only around these tasks. Omit for the whole graph; keys that match nothing draw nothing.

status.description: Keep only these statuses. Seeds survive regardless.

max_chars.description: The diagram budget, default 4000. Raise or lower it freely; the default exists so a big graph cannot land whole by accident, not to stop you asking.

override_token.description: From a previous overflow: renders that graph whole without needing to know its size. Single use.
